item.title: [ABC Action News / Tampa Bay 28] Think twice before driving through floodwaters: One wrong turn could cost you $10,000
item.description: Driving through floodwaters can cost you $10,000 in engine damage. Manatee County's drainage improvements helped avoid major flooding this weekend, but experts warn: turn around, don't drown.
